支持 page、module、builtin、auto。清单不能有 script: Supports page, module, builtin and auto modes. Manifests cannot contain script tags. Use release/legacy folders for the original site; the new site imports ZIP directly, while the original workbench requires extraction.
方式一 / ZIP 或完整案例文件夹: Option 1 / ZIP or complete case folder
上传含 atlas-case-manifest JSON 元信息块的单 HTML: Upload one HTML file containing an atlas-case-manifest JSON metadata block. Download built-in self-contained cases from the library as examples.
关系边明确显示满足与排除的尺寸约束；排序另由参考票数决定。: Edges show satisfied and rejected size constraints; reference votes determine the ranking separately.
词项权重来自参考语料，原始语句的来源保留在草稿中。: Term weights come from reference texts; the draft preserves each source sentence.
AI视图显示实际动作或Q值；基线视图显示固定动作；策略差异显示受控减基线。: AI mode shows actual actions or Q-values; baseline mode shows fixed actions; policy difference shows controlled minus baseline.

概念示意不代表真实井况；下方实验图来自实际计算。: Concept diagrams are illustrative; experiment plots come from actual computation.
当前步骤的实际计算证据: Actual computation evidence for this step
运行方法，检查它为何有效: Run the method and inspect why it works
展开 What / Why / How 方法讲解: Expand the What / Why / How explanation
同一测试数据同时计算智能方法与简单基线；结果不保证智能方法总是更好。: The method and baseline use identical test observations. The intelligent method is not guaranteed to win.
仅引用原句；缺失字段保持未提供，不补写地质结论。: Quote source sentences only; missing fields remain unspecified and no geological conclusions are invented.
当前观测的多个输出: Multiple outputs for the current observation
各目标使用独立回归系数；催化裂化收率额外截断为非负并归一化到100%。: Each target has separate regression coefficients. FCC yields are additionally clipped to nonnegative values and normalized to 100%.
浏览器本地学习 · 独立测试 · 合成教学数据: Browser-local learning · Held-out evaluation · Synthetic teaching data
参考与独立检验分离: Reference and held-out evaluation are separate
当前独立检验中智能方法更好，仍需检查失败条件。: The method performs better on this test; still inspect failure conditions.
当前设置下智能方法未超过基线，应复查数据与假设。: The method does not exceed the baseline here; review data and assumptions.
当前设置下两者接近，额外复杂度未必值得。: The two are close here; added complexity may not be worthwhile.
分布变化后不保证90%覆盖。: 90% coverage is not guaranteed after a distribution shift.
误差来自当前独立测试，不是预置准确率。: Errors come from the current held-out test, not preset accuracy.
图像数值来自观测；点击像素检查输入和贡献。: Image values come from observations. Click a pixel to inspect inputs and contributions.
曲线或颜色来自当前观测形态，不是按预测标签重新绘制。: Curves and colors come from the current observation, not a rendering of predicted labels.
轨迹由动作与独立扰动逐步推进；固定策略使用相同扰动。: Actions and independent disturbances advance the trajectory; the fixed policy receives identical disturbances.
已遮挡目标值不参与推断；可见段和候选位置保留原始索引。: Masked target values are excluded from inference; visible segments and candidates retain original indices.
通道分别按当前最小值和最大值缩放，只比较趋势；原值见样本表。: Channels are independently min-max scaled for trend comparison; the sample table retains original values.
灰区不满足约束，星号为预算内最高预测响应；点击格点检查数值。: Grey cells are infeasible. The star is the best feasible predicted response. Click a cell to inspect values.
第一条为当前结果，第二条为基线，第三条为评估标签；错误视图标记错分。: Rows show the current result, comparison and evaluation labels. Error mode highlights misclassifications.
显示实际动作或当前状态Q值，收益来自模拟过程。: Actual actions or current-state Q-values are shown; rewards come from the simulation.
对角线表示预测等于观测；误差视图显示预测减观测。: The diagonal means prediction equals observation. Error mode shows predicted minus observed.
曲线为训练回合实际回报，不是损失或准确率。: The curve shows actual episode returns, not loss or accuracy.
曲线来自真实拟合迭代。: The curve comes from actual fitting iterations.
该方法没有迭代训练损失；这里显示独立测试绝对误差。: This method has no iterative training loss; the plot shows held-out absolute errors.
二次项与交互项系数仅由独立参考样本拟合。: Quadratic and interaction coefficients are fitted using reference samples only.
贡献和给出归一化前收率；负值截断后总收率归一到100%。: Contributions give pre-normalized yields; negative values are clipped and totals normalized to 100%.
偏置加各标准化多项式贡献得到预测；统计关联不是因果关系。: Bias plus standardized polynomial contributions gives the prediction; association is not causation.
第一主方向来自正常参考集；标签只用于测试，不进入PCA或阈值。: The first principal direction comes from normal references. Test labels never enter PCA or threshold fitting.
各通道标准化重构残差的平方相加，再与正常参考分位数阈值比较。: Sum squared standardized channel reconstruction residuals and compare with the normal-reference quantile threshold.
逻辑回归从参考像素的真实观测特征学习权重，不读取目标图像掩膜。: Logistic regression learns reference observed-pixel features without reading the target mask.
贡献和为logit，经sigmoid形成像素分数；标注掩膜仅用于检验。: Contributions sum to a logit, whose sigmoid gives the pixel score. Masks are evaluation-only.
kNN保存参考形态的观测特征；不使用目标类别生成输入。: kNN stores observed reference-shape features; target labels do not generate inference features.
图形特征先按参考集标准化；距离最近的标注形态投票。: Shape features are standardized on references; nearby labeled shapes vote.
去噪滤波系数由独立参考含噪—干净对学习，不读取目标干净图。: Denoising coefficients are learned from a separate noisy/clean pair without reading the target clean image.
邻域观测的加权贡献生成中心值；简单基线仅取五点均值。: Weighted neighborhood contributions reconstruct the center; the baseline uses a five-point mean.
用独立完整参考井拟合跨曲线回归；目标井缺失段不参与拟合。: Complete independent reference wells fit cross-log regression; target gaps do not enter fitting.
只读取仍可用的其他曲线和已知深度相位，缺失目标值不进入特征；插值只使用缺口外端点: Only available auxiliary logs and known depth phase are read; hidden targets never enter features. Interpolation uses gap endpoints only.
已标注参考井的界面邻域训练窗口分类器；测试井标签不参与特征。: Reference boundary labels train a window classifier; test-well labels do not enter features.
多尺度左右均值差有助于区分噪声与持续跳变；输出为界面邻域候选，不是地层定名。: Multiscale contrasts help separate noise from persistent jumps. Outputs are boundary neighborhoods, not formation names.
小型关系图保存尺寸适配边；历史记录标准化距离产生候选票数，不是假装运行大模型。: A small relation graph stores compatibility edges. Standardized historical distances produce votes; no large model is implied.
先按已公开的几何范围过滤，再用历史近邻票数排序；没有适配边的工具不能因高票被选中: Filter by declared geometry ranges before ranking by historical-neighbor votes. Incompatible tools cannot win through high votes.
参考响应样本识别工具面作用；控制器在动作变化约束下最小化预测误差和动作代价。: Reference responses identify toolface effects; the controller minimizes predicted error and effort under action-change limits.
贡献和为已辨识模型预测的下一步偏移变化；轨迹图为加入独立扰动后的真实模拟状态，不: Contributions sum to model-estimated next offset change; the trajectory shows simulated states after independent disturbance.
Q表由450个合成训练回合更新；只比较同一模拟器内策略，不声称真实油藏最优。: 450 synthetic episodes update the Q-table. Policies are compared within one simulator without claiming field optimality.
显示当前离散含水—压力状态的三个Q值；动作约束过滤后取最大Q值，回报包含产油与产: Inspect three Q-values for the current water/pressure state. Choose the best allowed action; rewards balance oil and water penalties.
TF-IDF词表和权重只来自参考句；输出为可追溯的模板草稿，不生成无来源结论。: TF-IDF vocabulary and weights come only from reference sentences. The output is a traceable template draft without unsupported conclusions.
按句检索参考字段并加权投票；草稿直接引用原句，缺失和未知字段保持未提供。: Retrieve reference fields and vote by sentence; the draft quotes input lines and leaves missing or unknown fields unspecified.
逻辑回归权重从多指标参考记录拟合；风险分数不是校准过的现场事故概率。: Logistic weights are fitted on multivariable references; scores are not calibrated field-incident probabilities.
气测组分参考样本经过标准化，按实际多组分距离检索。: Gas-composition references are standardized and retrieved by actual multicomponent distance.
多指标贡献相加形成logit，再映射为分数；与单指标规则在同一测试集比较。: Multivariable contributions sum to a logit and score; compare with a single-indicator rule on identical test records.
总烃、重烃比和峰形指标联合投票；单总烃峰高不能唯一判定流体性质。: Total gas, heavy ratios and shape features vote jointly; one gas peak cannot uniquely determine fluid type.
